# Hyperlink

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders linked text that opens a URI or navigates to another page.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Implements `IElement`, `IRoleProvider`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Hyperlink(text: string, uri?: string, options?: HyperlinkOptions)
new Hyperlink(options: HyperlinkOptions & { text: string; })
```

## Properties

- [`color`](#color): Link text colour.
- [`fontName`](#fontname): Gets or sets the font name for the link text
- [`fontSize`](#fontsize): Gets or sets the font size for the link text.
- [`margin`](#margin): Margin around the link.
- [`semanticRole`](#semanticrole): The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. `SemanticRole.H1`, `SemanticRole.P`, `SemanticRole.Figure`).
- [`targetPageIndex`](#targetpageindex): Gets or sets the target 0-based page index (for internal links)
- [`text`](#text): Gets the link text to display
- [`underline`](#underline): Draws a line under the link text, in the link colour, placed as an underline decoration on text is.
- [`uri`](#uri): Gets or sets the URI (URL) that this hyperlink points to

### `color`

```typescript
color: Color
```

Link text colour. Accepts a palette token or hex on write.

Example, from `code-recipes/links-references/hyperlinks`:

```typescript
link.color = LINK;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/links-references/hyperlinks`:

```typescript
cta.color = Color.white;
```

### `fontName`


Example, from `code-recipes/links-references/hyperlinks`:

Example, from `code-recipes/links-references/hyperlinks`:

### `fontSize`

```typescript
fontSize: number
```

Gets or sets the font size for the link text.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'1cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

Example, from `code-recipes/links-references/hyperlinks`:

```typescript
cta.fontSize = 12;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/links-references/hyperlinks`:

```typescript
link.fontSize = 12;
```
